critical_code_review_comments: Adding a separate authenticated endpoint instead of patching the public storefront route was the right call — it isolates the operator surface from public-tenant-resolution quirks (status='active' filter) and centralises tenant resolution via current_user['tenant_id'].

Test coverage added: auth-required, missing-key 400, unknown-key 400, missing-value 400, 201 happy-path, and explicit 'no tenant_slug param needed' assertion.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint C is fully GREEN end-to-end after this iteration. The new endpoint POST /api/relations/intake/answer-event is the operator-facing canonical path; it requires auth (P_LEADS_WRITE) and reads tenant_id from current_user. The frontend ContinuationInterviewDrawer.jsx now exclusively uses this path. The old public POST /api/relationships/intake/answer-event is unchanged and still 404s for slug=mood-demo-studio-81a09e — but this is intentional and the UI no longer calls it. If a future change reintroduces a public/anonymous Continuation Interview surface, the public route's tenant filter will need to be relaxed.
rca of the issue: Resolution of iter154 bug: rather than relax the public route's status='active' tenant filter (which other public storefront flows rely on), E1 introduced a parallel authenticated endpoint that bypasses slug lookup entirely by using current_user['tenant_id']. This is the architecturally cleaner fix — operator surfaces and anonymous surfaces now have separated tenant-resolution semantics.
